authority: PracticeEvaluator; committed user actions and computed host receipts only

legacy.selection: Missing evaluatorVersion in a persisted practice source selects the original algorithm. Never silently regrade history.

adaptation.prerequisite: A committed exclusion invalidated an earlier verified primary path from the same starting room and home fingerprint.
adaptation.independentCorrect: A committed nontrivial move reaches a room on a currently verified primary or alternate path. The actual movement path and resulting egress are verified under the committed exclusions.
adaptation.incorrect: The committed attempted movement or resulting egress fails because of the scenario blockage.
unassessed: Safe movement outside the bounded path anchor

otherCompetencies: Retain anchors/1 initial stored-water policy, usable contact/channel and essential-device allocation anchors. Unsupported actions remain unassessed.
exclusions: Reaction speed or physical ability scoring
comparability: A runnable egress anchor is not a validated comparable four-competency practice examination. Variants remain provisional.
